title: Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks
summary: Ilya Sutskever, Oriol Vinyals, and Quoc V. Le submitted 'Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks' on September 10, 2014. The paper presents a general end-to-end approach to sequence learning using a multilayered LSTM to encode an input sequence into a fixed-dimensional vector and another deep LSTM to decode the target sequence.
significance: A documented sequence-learning research milestone that demonstrated an end-to-end neural approach for mapping input sequences to output sequences and evaluated it on English-to-French machine translation.

verification.note: The original arXiv record establishes the September 10 2014 submission date, title, authors, and the encoder/decoder LSTM method. The NeurIPS proceedings independently corroborate the paper and its 2014 conference publication.
